findings.title: Event listener registered per request is never removed
findings.description: events.on('update') is called for every SSE connection and never removed on req 'close', so listeners (and their captured res objects) accumulate forever and keep writing to closed sockets. Keep a reference to the handler and call events.off('update', handler) in req.on('close').
findings.suggestion: const handler = ...; events.on('update', handler); req.on('close', () => events.off('update', handler));
